gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-grantha: Loud and stencil-cut up top, with Wallpoet running smooth around every bend, while Noto Sans Grantha sits below in tall, flattened bowls. Pages of it should read without a single snag.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-gujarati: Noto Sans Gujarati reads clean and modern, its curved strokes stopping short before they turn inward. Wallpoet stays up above as the loud one, so the text underneath can simply flow.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-gunjala-gon: Wallpoet's lowercase climbs high and its letters are cut by thin gaps where the paper shows through. Make that heading small, though, and Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi's chunky strokes would take over.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-gurmukhi: Commanding from the first glance, Wallpoet carries a smooth path around each curve. Noto Sans Gurmukhi does the quieter job, with outward-pointing terminals that keep the text clean and steady.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-hebrew: Wallpoet takes the top with high-rising lowercase and gaps cut through each letter, a heading you can't miss. Noto Sans Hebrew then settles in beneath it, its big midsection and open curves doing the quiet work.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-hk: Noto Sans HK reads clean and businesslike, with large lowercase forms and brush ends that lift away before each curve closes. And Wallpoet above it keeps the louder voice, so a long page stays easy on the eye.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-imperial-ar: Big, bold and cut through with gaps. Wallpoet leads, and Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic follows in friendly sans-serif, its c ends pointing apart so extended reading goes down smoothly.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-inscription: Wallpoet opens the pair with a bold, commanding heading whose lowercase climbs high and whose letters show paper between the cuts. Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian follows with big open eyes on every e and a, so a long page stays easy to take in.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-jp: Bold and unmistakable, Wallpoet cuts its letters with thin gaps and smooth turns around each bend. Noto Sans JP sits underneath with a very tall x-height and sweeping curves, giving the loud heading a roomy sans-serif to lean on.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-kannada: Wallpoet is the loud, gap-cut headline voice. Noto Sans Kannada is the approachable partner, with a gentle bump up to capitals and s curves that open wide at both ends, which is the pair's real strength.
